name: Record-held answers reached and followed
purpose: Where the right answer to a request depends on a record the consumer's network holds, that record reaches the pass of the solution it belongs to and the pass's verdict follows it.
record: Per arm and knowledge mode (retrieved, all, none), the share of flow cases (evaluation/solution_passes) whose deciding record is in a considered solution's prompt (free) and whose pass cites it and reaches the expected verdict (real), with calls per case.
disadvantages: The cases are written on the hub's own public records; a consumer's records may hold the deciding fact in a shape no case has.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=a change to the arm, the briefs or the records] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the free stage passes every case: one case with the cheap tier] > all [sample=full | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the one case passes: every case with the cheap tier]

name: Work done right because each touched solution was considered, at a priced cost
purpose: When a piece of work's right result depends on a record a solution's network holds, the work's output uses that record and reaches the right result; when the work concerns no solution, consideration adds nothing; and what that costs in time and model calls is priced in the same number.
record: Per arm (off, always on, gated on), one number fixed before any arm was run: score = B - 0.5 N - 0.1 L - 0.1 K. B: the share of work cases (evaluation/solution_passes kind work, requests to do or change something whose right result a held record decides) whose work output meets every requirement of its case, each requirement counted met only with a quote the code finds in the output (the quote-checked rubric judge, never the writer). N: the share of abstain cases (work no solution concerns) where the arm added anything to the work's brief (a card, a block, a call). L: the arm's added seconds per work case, 0.25 of the median plus 0.75 of the p90, over 600 (ten minutes is what a work run may take: latency on a work path is priced far below a chat reply's). K: the arm's added model calls per case over 40. Gate (not the score): quick chat turns run no consideration, so the BAD-01..12 chat quality must stay within its own off-arm run-to-run range.
disadvantages: The work cases are on the hub's public records and a cheap worker stands in for the deep agent, so the output is a statement of the change, not the change made; a case's requirements say what the right result is, so a new kind of deciding record needs a new case; the abstain cases are few.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=a change to the arm, the briefs or the records: the deciding record reaches the work's brief and nothing reaches it on abstain cases] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the free stage passes: one work case with the cheap tier] > all [sample=full | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the one case passes: every work and abstain case with the cheap tier]
